policy.priority_source: Initial dual-mode Mock-PC ranking; later experiments may remove reviewer objections but do not silently reorder papers without a new comparable Mock-PC round.

entries.title: Noisy Rewards Write Noisy Memories: Reward Error as a Variance Amplifier in Self-Improving Agents
entries.why_priority: Highest Mock-PC rank and the only paper with a completed direct write-channel intervention plus a passed same-information prompt control.
entries.decisive_next_experiment: Live matched WebArena browser continuation under paired reward-conditioned memories, measuring terminal benchmark success and first divergence with the frozen source environment and evaluator.
blocking_dependencies: Reachable reset service or equivalent reproducible reset mechanism.
entries.reopen_condition: A source-faithful live Shopping environment and reset path become reachable from an authorized execution host.
forbid_before_reopen: Do not add more fixed-state first-action rollouts.
Do not add more fixed-evidence terminal-answer surrogate rollouts.
Do not interpret environment unavailability as scientific counterevidence.

entries.title: Temporal Skills Are a Causal Bottleneck in Evolving Time-Series Agents
entries.why_priority: Second Mock-PC rank; the decisive three-condition intervention is already specified and waits on one first-party evaluated-snapshot dependency.
entries.decisive_next_experiment: Frozen TimeSage-EV targeted temporal/exogenous skill injection versus matched generic-skill and no-skill controls on preregistered failure families.
blocking_dependencies: First-party frozen evaluated TimeSage-EV scenario snapshot or equivalent first-party inputs/outcomes/skill-interface artifacts.
entries.reopen_condition: A hashable first-party evaluated TimeSage-EV snapshot becomes available.
forbid_before_reopen: Do not fabricate or substitute a synthetic TimeSage evaluated snapshot.
Do not use remote-network failure as evidence that the public release is still empty.
Do not run targeted-skill outcome calls before failure-family labels and controls can be frozen on first-party artifacts.

entries.title: Failure Memories Are Not Neutral: Causal Provenance Effects in Self-Evolving Agents
entries.why_priority: Lowest Mock-PC rank and the explicit-provenance bridge has already exhausted its information value; only a source-faithful natural-memory swap can change the central causal claim.
entries.decisive_next_experiment: Source-faithful matched semantic-memory provenance swap on the financial AgentDojo/ReasoningBank setting, including forward and reverse swaps.
blocking_dependencies: Auditable access to the exact qwen3.7-flash-2026-07-15 executor snapshot.
Auditable access to qwen3.7-text-embedding for source-faithful top-1 retrieval.
A faithful AgentDojo bridge plus aggregate-fidelity gate, or first-party per-query audit artifacts from the financial study.
entries.reopen_condition: Exact executor+embedding access becomes available, or the financial-audit authors release per-query artifacts sufficient for the natural matched provenance swap.
forbid_before_reopen: Do not add more explicit SUCCESS/FAILURE metadata-tag bridge rollouts.
Do not substitute a different embedding model and call it source-faithful reproduction.
Do not treat the 0.000 bridge difference as equivalence because no equivalence margin was preregistered.
